prompt:
Desktop resume website, edge to edge, no browser chrome. Adapt the reference images' paper, bamboo ribs, and inner glow into a working page. Do not copy their layout. Do not make a dark software dashboard.

The page is a dim room of paper lanterns. One tall washi column is lit from a bulb inside and fills most of the screen. Written on that glowing paper, crisp and readable: Mohd Sohel Deshmukh, Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, April 2025 – Present, Pune. A vermilion stamp on the paper is a button: deshmukh.sohel@yahoo.com. Small links on the paper: Home, Work, Contact.

On the dark wall beside it, three flat folded outlines, unlit, labeled: Senior Programmer, April 2022 – June 2025; Programmer, July 2019 – April 2022; Software Engineer, Softworx Technologies, March 2017 – July 2019. No invented biography.

Washi ivory where the bulb is on, bamboo rib lines, charcoal room, one vermilion stamp. A website made of paper volumes, not an app with cards.
